entity.summary: Automated-market-maker decentralized exchange within the Fathom Protocol ecosystem on XDC Network, supporting token swaps and liquidity pools.
entity.notes: Fathom's first-party site identifies Fathom DEX as its own stableswap DEX and links the live dapp. First-party documentation describes the DEX AMM and pair factory on XDC. Current DefiLlama and CoinGecko observations report non-zero DEX activity. The 2022 establishment year from CoinGecko is not promoted to launch_date because no exact first-party launch date was established in this review.

evidence.title: Fathom Liquidity Protocol — Fathom DEX entry point
evidence.notes: First-party Fathom site identifies 'Fathom DEX' as Fathom's own stableswap DEX and links the live dapp at dapp.fathom.fi.

evidence.title: Fathom Protocol documentation — DEX AMM and factory
evidence.notes: First-party documentation describes the Fathom DEX UniswapV2Factory contract as the component responsible for creating and managing liquidity pairs for token exchanges.

evidence.title: Fathom AMM metrics
evidence.notes: DefiLlama currently classifies Fathom AMM as a DEX/AMM on XDC and reports non-zero TVL and cumulative DEX volume, supporting active classification.
